meta_description: 30A ESCAPES presents… “Ocean Ayer Carriage House,” a charming 1-bedroom, 1-bath retreat in Seacrest Beach. This coastal getaway sleeps 4, offering access to a 12,000 sq ft community lagoon pool, private beach access, and 2 bikes for exploring the area. Enjoy mode
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “Ocean Ayer Carriage House,” a charming 1-bedroom, 1-bath retreat in Seacrest Beach. This coastal getaway sleeps 4, offering access to a 12,000 sq ft community lagoon pool, private beach access, and 2 bikes for exploring the area. Enjoy modern amenities including stainless steel kitchen appliances, a spacious primary suite with en-suite bathroom, a twin bunk area and a relaxing balcony off the living room. Learn more below…👇 *** HIGHLIGHTS ***Community Lagoon Pool: A 12,000 sq ft pool with a waterfall, zero-entry splash zone, and ample seatingPrivate Beach Access: Direct access to the beach via seasonal tram service for easy transportation2 Bikes Included: 2 bikes are provided for exploring Seacrest BeachSeasonal Tram: Convenient transportation to and from the beach and community areasSleeps 4 Comfortably: Ideal for small families or couples with 1 bedroom, twin bunk area and 1 bathModern Kitchen: Stainless steel appliances and bar seating for 2*** LIVING AREAS ***The cozy living room is the perfect space for unwinding after a day at the beach. A flat-screen TV provides entertainment, and the balcony off the living room offers a peaceful place to enjoy the coastal breeze. Comfortable Seating: A relaxing sofa and chairs for loungingFlat-Screen TV: Great for family movie nights or catching up on your favorite showsBalcony Access: Step out for fresh air and stunning views of the surroundings *** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The fully equipped kitchen features sleek stainless steel appliances and bar seating for two. Whether you’re preparing a quick breakfast or a full meal, you’ll have everything you need to make your stay enjoyable.Stainless Steel Appliances: Modern and fully equipped for all your cooking needsBar Seating for 2: Ideal for casual meals or enjoying drinks togetherFully Stocked Kitchen: Everything from cookware to utensils for easy meal preparation*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS *** The community offers an incredible 12,000 sq ft lagoon pool with a waterfall, zero-entry splash zone, and plenty of seating for relaxation. With private beach access and a seasonal tram service, you’ll enjoy a stress-free trip to the beach. Additionally, the living room features a balcony for a relaxing outdoor space to enjoy the coastal breeze. Lagoon Pool: Large pool with a waterfall and splash zone for fun and relaxationPrivate Beach Access: Easy access to Seacrest Beach, with seasonal tram service for added convenienceSeasonal Tram: Quick and easy transportation to and from the beachBalcony Off Living Room: A perfect space to unwind and enjoy the fresh air and scenic views *** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS *** Primary Suite: Enjoy a king-sized bed with luxurious linens and an en-suite bathroom with a walk-in shower for your comfortBunk Area: Features a twin-over-twin bunk, perfect for kids or additional guests *** LOCATION & COMMUNITY *** Nestled between the iconic Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, Ocean Ayer Carriage House offers easy access to all the best Seacrest Beach has to offer. Located steps from the stunning 12,000 sq ft Lagoon Pool, you can also take a 4-Minute Bike Ride to the beach or hop on the seasonal tram for a quick ride with all your gear. With 2 bikes provided, exploring the area has never been easier or more fun. Lagoon Pool: 12,000 sq ft paradise with zero-entry splash zone, waterfalls, and plenty of loungersPrivate Beach Access: Just a 4-minute bike ride or short tram ride to the pristine Gulf watersPeddler’s Pavilion: 2-minute bike ride to boutique shops, live music, dining, and seasonal nightlifeScenic Walking Trails: Perfect for exploration, relaxation, and enjoying nature's beautyWalkable & Bike-Friendly: Easy stroll or bike ride to Rosemary Beach (8 minutes) and Alys Beach (12 minutes)South Walton’s Tallest Sand Dunes: Unique and stunning natural feature in the area*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW *** Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independently.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.This property has 2 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes, a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 40754STRO #: STR-040754
